issues.detail: Hebrew 'וְטוּר סָבִיב בָּהֶם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם' means 'a row round about within them, round about the four of them' (referring to the four tables/stands), but Chinese says '四圍有四行環繞它們' ('there are four rows surrounding them'), adding '四行' (four rows) and misrendering 'טוּר' (singular 'row') as plural '四行'.

Hebrew 'וּמְבַשְּׁלוֹת עָשׂוּי מִתַּחַת הַטִּירוֹת סָבִיב' means 'and cooking places were made under the rows round about' (i.e., under the rows/ledges), but Chinese says '四圍在城邑之下有造好的烹煮處' ('round about under the cities there are made cooking places'), adding '城邑' (cities) which is not in the Hebrew; the Hebrew has 'הַטִּירוֹת' (the rows), not 'cities'.
